- Map Desk: the World Map now lies on a painted cartographer's desk that pans and zooms with it, with a gold frame, a lantern with a soft blue glow, a 3D compass that holds north and swings when you drag the map, and two survivor notes written in the game's language. With it on, panning stops at the map's edges at every zoom. Settings > Look > Map Desk turns it off; it starts on only with the game's Ultra graphics preset.
- Mark places done: Ctrl + click a town, camp, sanctum, vault or other place to give it a check mark, and again to clear it. Marked places follow Completed Places: Hide, and Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y undo and redo marks too. A visited sanctum's check mark can be cleared the same way. Elixir Wells and Roots are left to the game.
- Nearby Creatures Only (Settings > Minimap): the minimap shows the live creatures within 75 m instead of their spawn points, with height arrows and a ring while an enemy fights you (red) or searches for you (amber), and G G outlines them through walls. Hide on World Map, under it, keeps their spawn points off the World Map too, except the creatures Find is looking for. Requested by cutegirl16owo.
- Hover names on the World Map show on a dark panel so they read on a crowded map. The hover name, Alt + click and Ctrl + click all follow the marker the game itself highlights.
- A place with both a quest and an unread rumor now shows the quest's name when you hover it: the Sunken Ancient City shows Follow The Melody.
- Settings are grouped under World Map, Minimap, Look and Filters. New in Look: Dungeon Maps turns the Hollow Hall, vault and spire maps off, and the map then opens on the hall's entrance.
- Filter presets can be saved from the keyboard with Ctrl+Alt+1 to Ctrl+Alt+5 (SavePreset1 to SavePreset5 under [Keys]), and the preset keys no longer also reach the game. Requested by Ykses.
- Nothing around you is hidden any more: the mod's icons and check marks draw under your arrow and its ring, the key hints and the legend instead of being left out. Creature and resource pins fill in nearest you first when there are more than the map draws at once.
Reported bugs fixed:
- Alt + click on an Ancient Spire could hide a nearby ore or chest row instead.
- Alt + click didn't hide a lore rumor's "?" pin.
- Ctrl + click on a quest pin marked the place under it done.
- Long names in the Map Key ran under the padlock and ON / OFF, and the presets' tip ran out of its box.
